figurative_meaning_en: The origin or emergence of slanderous or condemnable talk
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে তার নামে কথা জন্মানো শুরু হয়েছে।
এই ঘটনা থেকে অনেক নিন্দুকথা জন্মাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Rumors about him have started circulating in the village.
This incident will give rise to a lot of slanderous talk.
note: This idiom reflects the Bengali cultural emphasis on oral traditions and the impact of words in community dynamics.
